introduction: How can you improve your English listening skills? Phil's got some top tips for Fatosh - and you! To

vocabulary.definition: text displayed at the bottom of a movie or TV screen that translates or transcribes the dialogue
vocabulary.example: I always watch foreign films with English subtitles to help me understand the dialogue.

vocabulary.definition: to say or estimate that (a specified thing) will happen in the future or will be a consequence of something
vocabulary.example: Before watching the movie, she tried to predict the ending based on the trailer.

vocabulary.definition: evidence or information used to solve a problem or make a decision
vocabulary.example: The detective carefully examined the clues left at the crime scene to identify the suspect.

vocabulary.definition: consisting of many interconnecting parts or elements; intricate
vocabulary.example: The instructions for assembling the furniture were so complicated that he needed help.

vocabulary.definition: causing someone to feel mild astonishment or shock
vocabulary.example: It was surprising to see her at the party because she said she couldn't make it.

vocabulary.definition: a way of carrying out a particular task, especially the execution or performance of an artistic work or a scientific procedure
vocabulary.example: The chef demonstrated various cooking techniques to create a perfect dish.
